receipts.first_text_witness: You're standing in the grocery store checkout line with $180 worth of food in your cart doing that thing you've done for the past 3 years, the mental math. $180 for groceries means $220 left for the week, which means gas money is tight, which means you're walking to work Thursday and Friday, which means you need to meal prep because you can't afford to buy lunch. The cashier scans your items and says your total and you tap your card and something absolutely bizarre happens.
receipts.last_text_witness: and beyond and people who get stuck forever. It's not intelligence, it's not luck, it's not secret strategies, it's whether you understand that crossing the threshold doesn't mean the race is over. It means you finally have the stamina to keep running. And this time, you're not running from something. You're running towards something. That's what changes after your first $5,000 month. Not the money, the direction.
